name: Ṛta is the road
text: Ṛta has no road. It is the road.

inspired_by.source: Ṛta, the order Varuna keeps in the Rigveda
inspired_by.note: Original composition after Ṛta, the order Varuna keeps in the Rigveda. Not a translation, and not a quotation.

sources: the owner's draft of nomadic-migration sayings for the cutscenes, 2026-10-01
